x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
num, den = 0, 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    candidate_low = (i * x) // y
    candidate_high = candidate_low + 1

    def update_fraction(val, idx):
        nonlocal num, den
        diffA = abs((den * y) * ((x * idx) - (y * val)))
        diffB = abs((y * idx) * ((den * x) - (num * y)))
        if diffA < diffB or (diffA == diffB and idx < den):
            den = idx
            num = val

    update_fraction(candidate_low, i)
    update_fraction(candidate_high, i)

print(f"{num}/{den}")
</translated_code>
